claim: ADR 0238 (founder 2026-09-29, verbatim: "managers/owners+ the people they assign"): creating a storage zone (POST /storage-locations/:rid), a PATCH carrying any field but current_count, deleting a zone, and a rename on the cellar floor (ZonesService.confirm when the name changes) are 403 unless the caller is an owner or manager of the house or a staff member whose active membership carries user_restaurant_access.zone_setup_access (migration an_owner_or_manager_may_assign_who_sets_up_zones, NOT NULL DEFAULT false). Only an owner or manager of the same house sets it (PUT /storage-locations/:rid/setup-access/:userId), only for a staff member, audited as zone_setup_access_changed. A count alone (current_count) and placing/removing wines stay open to every member (OD-200). Pinned by zone-setup-access.spec.ts (50 of 57 red on 2a79581d7).
